title: Avoid BOOLEAN cast lowercase allocation
description: Replace string-to-BOOLEAN cast matching's to_ascii_lowercase allocation with direct ASCII case-insensitive literal checks.

criteria: String-to-BOOLEAN coercion no longer allocates lowercase strings
Accepted true literals true/t/1/yes/on remain recognized case-insensitively
Accepted false literals false/f/0/no/off remain recognized case-insensitively
Invalid string error text preserves the original input

notes: coerce_to_boolean still trims strings before matching accepted BOOLEAN literals.
The invalid-literal branch still reports the original untrimmed string.
Non-string BOOLEAN coercion behavior is unchanged.
